checks.do: Whether the request URL is the product's base URL with the endpoint appended, on api.zsapi.net (or the beta or government host the tenant uses).

commercial-host.statement: The OneAPI host for commercial customers is api.zsapi.net.

quotes: The OneAPI host for commercial customers is api.zsapi.net.

relative-endpoints.statement: Each API has its own base path, and every endpoint is relative to that base URL: a ZIA call to /users goes to https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/users, and ZPA, Client Connector and Cloud & Branch Connector calls append the endpoint to their own base URLs.

quotes: All endpoints are relative to the base URL.
you must send the API request to the following URL: https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/users.
API requests to ZPA, Client Connector, and Cloud & Branch Connector endpoints must use the respective base URLs with the endpoints appended at the end.

base-path-table.statement: The guide's base paths are: ZIA `/zia/api/v1`; ZPA `/zpa/mgmtconfig/v1`, `/zpa/mgmtconfig/v2` and `/zpa/userconfig/v1` (the last for SCIM attribute and group endpoints); ZDX `/zdx/v1`; Authentication Service `/ziam/admin/api/v1`; Client Connector `/zcc/papi/public/v1`; Cloud & Branch Connector `/ztw/api/v1`; Business Insights `/bi/api/v1`; EASM `/easm/easm-ui/v1`; Cellular `/zcell/config/api/v1`; Event Monitoring & Notification `/event-monitoring`; Unified RBAC `/urbac/urbac`; AI Security `/aisecurity/aispm/v1` (AI Infrastructure) and `/aisecurity/airt/api/v2` (AI Red Teaming); AI Guard `/aiguard/v1`.

quotes: | ZIA API | /zia/api/v1 | https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1 |
Supported Base Paths: /zpa/mgmtconfig/v1 /zpa/mgmtconfig/v2 /zpa/userconfig/v1
For endpoints to retrieve SCIM attribute details and SCIM group details, /userconfig/v1 is used as the base URI.

easm-example-path.statement: The same guide's EASM example request uses `https://api.zsapi.net/easm-ui/v1/organizations`, without the `/easm` prefix its base-path table gives.

quotes: url = "https://api.zsapi.net/easm-ui/v1/organizations"
| EASM API | /easm/easm-ui/v1 | https://api.zsapi.net/easm/easm-ui/v1 |

beta-host.statement: A beta OneAPI endpoint uses api.beta.zsapi.net as the host with the same base path for each API, for example https://api.beta.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/users.

quotes: Zscaler also supports a beta endpoint for OneAPI that uses api.beta.zsapi.net as the host. The basePath remains the same for each API
https://api.beta.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/users

zpa-customer-id.statement: ZPA requests need a `customerId`, the customer's ZPA tenant ID, which can be read from the ZPA OneAPI resource's scope in Authentication Service or copied from the ZPA API Keys page.

quotes: API requests to ZPA endpoints require a customerId parameter, which represents the customer's ZPA tenant ID.
Your customer ID is displayed as part of the scope and you can copy this value.
On the API Keys page, click Copy Customer ID.
Obtaining the ZPA customer ID from Authentication Service
Click ZPA OneAPI to expand the resource.

cellular-customer-id.statement: Cellular requests likewise need a `customer_id`, the customer's Cellular tenant ID (spelled 'Celullar' in the guide).

quotes: API requests to Cellular endpoints require a customer_id parameter, which represents the customer's Celullar tenant ID.

go-ziam-routing.statement: The Go SDK's OneAPI client checks for the `ziam` prefix before the `zia` prefix so that ZIdentity calls are not metered against ZIA's rate limiter, and sends `ziam` and `admin` paths through its default HTTP client.

quotes: ZIAM must be checked before ZIA: "ziam/admin/api/v1/..." has "zia" as a
meter it against ZIA's rate limiter
return client.oauth2Credentials.HTTPClient // Use default client for ZIdentity admin endpoints
